name: Global Health Ltd
title: Global Health Ltd - 543654 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Medanta FY26 supply build-out continues: 623 beds added, ~2,700 greenfield beds and FY27 capex INR 800–900 crore; mature-hospital margin 24.4% and Noida losses narrowing (Q4 loss INR 236m vs Q3 INR 320m).

utilisation.quote: representing occupancy of approximately 61% on expanded bed capaci ty and around 64% excluding Noida Hospital

capex.peers_comment: Management cited two competitor hospitals coming up in Gurgaon around September-October, but did not describe their capacity in detail.
capex.quote: the overall capex for the year will be somewhere around INR 800 crores to INR 900 crores

triggers.label: FY27 capex INR 800–900 crore
triggers.quote: the overall capex for the year will be somewhere around INR 800 crores to INR 900 crores

triggers.label: Quarter occupancy ~61%, ~64% ex-Noida
triggers.quote: representing occupancy of approximately 61% on expanded bed capaci ty and around 64% excluding Noida Hospital

triggers.label: Noida Q4 loss narrowed
triggers.quote: Q4 loss reduced to INR 236 million even as bed capacity expanded from 328 to 382

guidance.quote: we are feeling fairly confident about the margin profile remaining in this kind of 24% - 25% range
Next year, it will be in the range of INR 600 crores to INR 700 crores.

guidance.value: ~500 beds short term; ~2,700 beds via 5 greenfield projects over 3–4 years
guidance.quote: the company expects to add approximately 500 beds across its existing hospitals with a minimum capex investment

red_flags.label: Noida ramp-up losses; occupancy ~30%
red_flags.quote: Our occupancy in our Noida hospital is currently running somewhere around 30%

red_flags.label: Mature-hospital margin down 40 bps
red_flags.quote: Matured margins were nominally down by 40 basis points during the year

evasions.quote: I don't want to give you a definitive commitment because it really depends on how much accumulated losses we are carrying

evasions.topic: Gurgaon competitor impact on doctor attrition
evasions.quote: we are not overly worried either on the demand side or on our ability to attract or retain clinical talent
